resources.title: Report Type & Filter Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet for choosing a report type's A-with-B vs. A-with-or-without-B relationship and planning standard, field-to-field, and cross filters before building -- pre-filled with Lesson 1's Meridian Outdoor Supply cautionary example, where the wrong relationship choice silently excluded 220 Accounts with no error at all.

resources.title: Dashboard Component Planning Template
resources.description: A worksheet mapping each dashboard component to its source report, widget type, measured value, and grouping, with the chart-type decision rule (parts-of-a-whole vs. comparison vs. trend vs. sequence vs. single number) -- pre-filled with Lesson 19's full pipeline-dashboard combination (funnel, metric, at-risk table, owner bar chart).

resources.title: Folder & Sharing Permissions Checklist
resources.description: A checklist covering folder access levels (Viewer/Editor/Manager), the subfolder-inheritance gotcha, private/hidden folders, and how to diagnose a 'why can people see this report' ticket -- grounded in Lesson 10's core rule that access to a report is really access to its folder.
